description: Lu Xun, young chinese commander in the supplied pixel art style. A blue cap, a green scarf, light silver armor over a white robe with a red skirt and red cape, dark boots. He holds a burning torch upright in the right hand
face: A young clear face, no beard.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the blue cap, the green scarf, silver shoulder armor, the red skirt and cape, the burning torch at his right side.
guard_action: the right hand lifts what it holds up beside the right shoulder, the left hand lowers, the left foot settles half a step forward

actions.idle: Calm ready stance holding the torch up, breathing
actions.move: Brisk walk in place with small steps, robe swaying, torch held up, seamless loop. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.b1: Upward flick. Frames 3-6 the knees bend and the torch is lowered in front; frames 7-8 the body straightens up tall and it is flicked from below to high above the head; frames 9-11 hold high. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The torch stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a2: Open-palm push. The torch stays at his right side. Frames 3-6 the empty LEFT hand draws back; frames 7-8 the left shoulder turns forward, body side-on, and the open left palm pushes straight out; frames 9-11 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The torch stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b3: Two-handed push. Frames 3-6 both hands gather in front of the chest; frame 7 the left foot steps forward; frame 8 both hands push straight out together; frames 9-11 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The torch stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s6: Circle and spread. Frames 3-5 the torch draws one full circle above the head; frame 6 he crouches; frames 7-8 a step forward and both hands spread wide and low in front; frames 9-12 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The torch stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b2: Downward stroke. Frames 3-6 he stands tall and raises the  above the head; frames 7-8 he drops into a deep knee bend and draws it straight down in front; frames 9-11 hold low.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 b1 → a2 → b3, 전법 s6. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정. 횃불은 손 위쪽만 뼈대에 넣었다(손~불꽃 끝). 손 아래 자루는 그림에서 따라온다.
